description: Before installing a dependency: does the npm or PyPI package exist, is the version published, deprecated or yanked, which known vulnerabilities does it carry (OSV.dev, with fix version) and which does the latest. Catches invented package names. Names and versions are sent to OSV.dev, npm and PyPI. verdict FAIL = missing package/version or high/critical vulnerability.

manifest.description: Or the text of a package.json or requirements.txt.

name: package_check
